text:
Governor Caleb Mutfwang of Plateau State has appealed to President Bola Tinubu to help the state government return Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in the state to their ancestral lands.
Thousands of people were forced to flee their homes in the last few years following violent attacks in some communities of Barikin Ladi, Mangu, Bokkos, Riyom and Bassa LGAs.
Speaking on Saturday during the 2027 presidential campaign held at Zaria Road, Jos North Local Government Area of the state, Governor Mutfwang said President Tinubu had done well in the fight against insecurity, but the return of the IDPs to their homes requires substantial intervention.
The campaign rally attracted top political figures from across the country, including Tinubu, Vice President Kashim Shettima, governors, ministers, and other dignitaries.
Governor Mutfwang said thousands of Plateau residents have been forced out of their homes by attacks and have been living in camps for years, explaining that many of them want to return homes.
He noted that returning the IDPs to their ancestral lands would restore their dignity, allow them to farm again, and rebuild their lives.
“In the last three months, we have seen what you have done in the fight against insurgency. Like you always say, you will defeat insurgency and we are seeing victory on the way. We have been working hard to fight all forms of criminality and we believe you will lead us in that direction. We will continue to solicit your help to make sure our people that are internally displaced return to their homes. This requires a substantial intervention. We are confident that what you did before, you will do it again,” Mutfwang said.
The governor called on the Federal Government to intensify security operations in the affected communities and provide support for resettlement, promising that come 2027, the people of the state would vote him massively.
He assured the crowd at the campaign rally that his administration would continue to work with security agencies and relevant authorities to ensure lasting peace in Plateau State.
Governor Mutfwang also appreciated President Tinubu for the projects and development programmes initiated by the Federal Government in Plateau State, mentioning ongoing road construction, improvements in security, support for agriculture, and youth empowerment programmes.
